KeyNpcSpec.description: A combat-capable key NPC or boss (maps to `build_key_npc`).

area.description: Resref of the area to place the character in (must exist in the module).

bearing.description: Compass facing in degrees: 0 north, 90 east. Default 0.

conversation.description: Resref of an existing dialog to attach.

domains.description: Cleric only: exactly two domains.2da rows.

faction.description: Default "hostile" (a boss). Use "commoner" for a friendly NPC.

level.description: Level the character has when it spawns.

name.description: Display name shown in the game.

powerLevel.description: Default "standard"; "tougher" and "epic" are for a real boss.

resref.description: Blueprint resref, also the tag: lower-case letters, digits and underscore, at most 16 characters.

x.description: X position in metres (10 m per tile, 0 = west edge).

y.description: Y position in metres (10 m per tile, 0 = south edge).

PcClass.description: classes.2da row: 0 Barbarian, 1 Bard, 2 Cleric, 3 Druid, 4 Fighter, 5 Monk, 6 Paladin, 7 Ranger, 8 Rogue, 9 Sorcerer, 10 Wizard.

PcRace.description: racialtypes.2da row: 0 Dwarf, 1 Elf, 2 Gnome, 3 Halfling, 4 Half-Elf, 5 Half-Orc, 6 Human.
